patch.sql:
select
    distinct
    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
patch.explanation: The raw.orders source contains exact duplicate rows (same order_key and all other column values). The staging model stg_orders previously selected rows directly, causing the unique_stg_orders_order_key check to fail with 300 duplicate order_key values. By adding SELECT DISTINCT we remove these exact duplicate rows while preserving the original column names and data types, satisfying the uniqueness check without altering any non-duplicate data.
